# Documentation conventions (`doc/`)

`doc/` is the user-facing reference. The docs site publishes it verbatim at each release tag and an LLM agent reads one page at a time, so every page stands alone.

## Rules

- One `#` per file, as its first line, then a one-sentence lead (the site copies it as the page description), then a bare-list ToC. Never skip heading levels.
- Layout is `doc/<section>/<page>.md`, lowercase `[a-z0-9-]`: `architecture`, `basics`, `getting-started`, `guides`. No `doc/index.md`.
- Put `<a name="kebab-slug"></a>` immediately before every `##` and list the slug in the ToC. Keep an existing slug: other pages link it.
- Open with the answer, state defaults and failure modes. A `basics/` page gets a Gotchas table (mistake, fix) and every page ends with `## Related Documentation`. `python3 -I tool/check-docs.py` must print 0 issues.
- Samples use `dart` and `bash` fences. Every symbol, config key and command exists in `lib/` or `install.yaml`; the package has no `bin/`, so commands are `dart run magic:dowel <command>`. Tables are left-aligned (`:-----`), identifiers in backticks.
- Links are relative `.md` paths inside `doc/`; a target outside `doc/` is never published. Backend facts follow `magic-starter-laravel`'s `src/routes/api.php`.
- Never in `doc/`: API dumps, changelog entries, marketing, counts of features or screens, release-status wording, em or en dashes.

## Surface to page

| Change in `lib/` | Page |
|:-----------------|:-----|
| `MagicStarterConfig`, `assets/stubs/install/magic_starter_config.stub` | `getting-started/configuration.md` |
| `lib/src/cli/` commands and flags, `install.yaml`, `pubspec.yaml` constraints | `getting-started/installation.md`, `basics/cli.md` |
| `MagicStarterManager`, the `MagicStarter` facade, sub-themes, `MagicStarterPageChrome` | `architecture/manager.md` |
| `MagicStarterServiceProvider`, its listeners and Gate abilities | `architecture/service-provider.md` |
| `MagicStarterViewRegistry`, default view, layout and modal keys, slots | `architecture/view-registry.md` |
| `lib/src/http/controllers/` and `concerns/` | `architecture/controllers.md`, `guides/state-management.md` |
| `MagicStarterTheme.fromWind`, `MagicStarterTokens`, button and field themes | `guides/wind-theme-adoption.md` |
| A screen, route or controller of one feature | the matching `basics/` page |
